notes: E-mess (IISc): Add-what-you-ate now has a Today's E-mess meal button that lists every meal whose time has already passed, lets you tick dishes across them, then set amount and time for each on one page. Plus the earlier Exercised enlarge/flip body map and the day's E-mess menu in meal reminders. Exercised flow: a search bar plus the front/back body map, with a new Enlarge view that shows one side at a time and a Flip button for precise muscle picking; the muscles you pick are named as you go. New E-mess (IISc) menu: a profile toggle that surfaces the day's E-mess breakfast/lunch/snacks/dinner in your meal reminders (each meal on its own, with an Exercised prompt), driven by the weekly rota; the whole menu stays searchable. Footer now links to the author's site and a contact email.
